Những Điều Cần Tránh Khi Trang Trí Nhà C.excerpt: Decorating a home is not simple. Especially in small apartments, doing it the wrong way will make the home feel even more cramped.
content: What to Avoid When Decorating a Small Home
Decorating a home is not simple. Especially in small apartments, doing it the wrong way will make the home feel even more cramped.
Using only light colors
Typically, for small rooms and homes, owners choose paint or wallpaper in bright tones. Colors such as white, beige and cream are quite common in small spaces today.
Use color skillfully and you can still get a perfect space

However, once this common palette solves the problem of making the room feel "less" cramped, your modest space can easily become boring. If you love white, add furniture in contrasting colors so the room gains accents and depth.

In small rooms, a bold color or a deep, dark tone can also give the space more depth. This way, your room will shine without worrying about how small it is. With strong, characterful colors, use them concentrated on details of the furniture. This helps avoid clutter and a counterproductive result.
Not daring to use patterned wallpaper
When choosing wallpaper for a modestly sized room, many people skip patterned designs. They think these will make the room look busy.
According to experts, in small homes, choosing patterned wallpaper adds an accent that attracts and distracts the eye, so that no one pays attention to the size of the room anymore.
Using only small furniture

Many people still think that if their home is relatively small, then of course the furniture should be small too. However, a small space combined with small furniture makes visitors feel uncomfortable.
So, instead of buying too many items of the same size, focus on buying what is necessary, even mid-sized pieces are fine.
Not making the most of the available space

In small homes, when decorating you need to make full use of the area and space in the room. For example, instead of buying a large wardrobe for the bedroom, choose a built-in wall wardrobe. Or mount the dish cabinet and the TV on the wall instead of buying a stand to place in some corner. This way of decorating saves the maximum amount of room area, makes the room feel larger and creates a comfortable feeling.
Hanging curtains too low or not using window curtains
A window without curtains will not make the room feel any bigger. Even short curtains hung just above the window will cut the room's height, making it feel smaller.
Hang curtains as close to the ceiling as possible to "cheat" the space
So try to find a way to install the curtains as close to the ceiling as you can. This helps create the illusion of a higher ceiling, adding to the area of an already cramped room.
Thinking you do not need decorations to create accents

A common mindset among people living in small spaces is to buy just enough furniture for daily life and forget to buy decorative items that give the room an accent. This may not affect much whether each home feels spacious or cramped, but it makes your home monotonous.

Bí quyết làm nên vẻ đẹp cho ngôi nhà với.excerpt: Once you have chosen paint colors that suit feng shui, you can combine 2-3 of them to make your home's facade more eye-catching and impressive.
content: Secrets to a Beautiful Home with 3 Magic Paint Colors
Once you have chosen paint colors that suit feng shui, you can combine 2-3 of them to make your home's facade more eye-catching and impressive.

According to the generating cycle of the five elements, paint colors that match the owner's element help limit the unfavorable influences of the environment on the home. Specifically: owners of the Water element suit sky blue, purple and black; people of the Fire element can paint red and pink; people of the Earth element should use yellow, earthy yellow or brown paint; owners of the Metal element are best suited to white, gray, silver, bronze and gold.

Once you have chosen paint colors that suit feng shui, you can combine 2-3 of them to make your home's facade more eye-catching and impressive. But keep in mind not to choose more than 3 colors for one house, as it creates a busy look, loses aesthetic appeal and feels stifling.
Gray-beige and blue combination

Exterior paint colors should be bright to breathe life into the home. You can paint the wall panels a gray-beige that feels cool, comfortable and clean, combined with blue windows, doors and roof tiles.
Milk coffee and terracotta orange combination

Combining milk coffee and terracotta orange paint gives the home an appearance that is both young and modern while remaining elegant. This is an architectural trend that has been popular in recent years.
Yellow and brown combination
This is an ideal combination for owners of the Earth element. While the yellow of sunlight brings a healthy vitality, the deep brown adds an air of nobility to the home.

Cách bài trí nội thất phòng khách cho nh.excerpt: The living room is the face of the whole home, the space where the family gathers to watch TV and where friends socialize. So arranging it smartly creates a perfect space to enjoy every moment!
content: HOW TO ARRANGE LIVING ROOM FURNITURE IN A SMALL HOME

A beautiful living room is the face of the whole home, the space where the family gathers to watch TV and where friends socialize. So arranging it smartly creates a perfect space to enjoy every moment!
Low tables and chairs

Choosing low furniture keeps sight lines unobstructed, so the living room looks bigger while still offering nice, cozy seating. You can design a floor-level table or a table and chair set with low wooden legs.
Transparent furniture
To bring in natural light and "cheat" more airy space in a small home, glass tabletops, transparent shelves or glass partitions give the living room a spacious and sparkling feel.
Optimized furniture

A small living room needs to make the most of its storage capacity so that the space looks tidier. For example: a coffee table with extra drawers, chairs with a shelf underneath, or the floor-to-ceiling gap used for built-in wall cabinets.
Single-color walls
Paint the walls a single color, or at most a combination of 2 colors. The tone should be bright, and combined with a white, ivory or light brown sofa, it will make the space feel larger.
Mirrors

Small homes often put a mirror in the living room because it is the most effective way to create the "illusion" of a larger space. One large mirror works well, or, more creatively, a set of mirrors in several small sizes.
By arranging small accessories and the furniture in the living room more carefully, the space will look brighter, more spacious and provide a cozy place to enjoy every moment!
